title: 03 Tidemark: notes
strengths: The tide as a sine curve with a now dot and the next high labelled on the curve is the Tide Guide idea rebuilt small; '2.1 m rising' with the time is what a swimmer needs.
A light 72 px time with the date and temperature as corner complications: it reads as a face, not an app.
slop_signals: Four layers of atmosphere art behind the data (starfield, crescent, cloud strata, horizon glints): the painted-sky watch face.
A crescent moon floats at the left of the horizon as a stray glyph while a cloud icon already gives the weather at the top.
Glow on the horizon line and on the now dot.
fixes: Keep one atmosphere layer (the gradient and the horizon); remove the stars, the crescent and the glints.
Remove the glow on the now dot; a solid dot with a ring is enough.

references.what: Height, 'Rising Tide', next high time and a sine curve with a now dot on a plain dark gradient.
24-hour tide chart with labelled highs and lows: the curve carries the labels, the background stays quiet.
Small tide cards: what survives at widget size is the curve, two times and a height.
Activity Analog face in the gallery: how few elements a shipped face holds.

owner.said: most of the watch screens are okay

round3.score_note: not re-audited; a date fix found by the fresh audit of mockups/08-made-with-opendesigner
